description: Gainsight widget with Download Data button and CDK overlay menu
criticalFeatures: Widget scope filtering - must click button in correct widget
Shadow DOM traversal - widget content is in shadow root
CDK overlay detection - menu renders in portal outside widget
Menu item extraction - must find all 5 menu options
Most recent menu selection - if multiple menus, select latest opened
regressionTests: CandidateFinder should find Download Data button in STORE LOCATION widget, not REVENUE
MenuDetector should identify CDK overlay as a menu
MenuDetector should extract all 5 menu items from portal
When multiple widgets have same button, scope hint should disambiguate
